items.title: Coequalizer of a proper groupoid on a locally Noetherian algebraic space exists and is finite
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: Construct X' = Spec_X(A) with A the equalizer of s^#, t^#: g_*O_Y -> h_*O_R (coherent by proper pushforward); verify the five properties - finite, proper, surjective (through the Stein factorization Y' = Spec(g_*O_Y) and finite-surjective Y' -> X'), universally injective (surjectivity of X' -> X' x_X X' via the equalizing factorization), universal homeomorphism when g surjective; then prove Y -> X' is THE coequalizer: reduce to X = X' categorically, check flat base change preserves the equalizer setup (flat base change for pushforward), and verify the colimit criterion of lemma-colimit-check-etale-locally with the affine Mor identification Mor_S(X,Z) = Hom(Gamma(Z), Gamma(X)). One sub-step (finite surjectivity of Y' -> X') carries 'some details omitted' with a precise hint (integral overring surjectivity + etale-local reduction).
